title: France and Saudi Arabia Agree $7B Dragon Ball Z Theme Park Near Paris
detail: Saudi entertainment and investment group Qiddiya will finance a 6-billion-euro (~$7B) theme park complex near Cergy-Pontoise, 30km northwest of Paris, including a park inspired by the manga franchise Dragon Ball Z expected to create around 22,000 jobs. The deal was among a raft of agreements spanning energy, defense, technology, transport and health signed during MBS's two-day Paris visit, part of the Kingdom's push under Vision 2030 to diversify its economy beyond oil and expand into leisure and entertainment abroad.

media.caption: Macron welcomes MBS at a state dinner at the Elysee Palace ahead of the theme park deal announcement
